subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 30, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - October 30, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

As we approach the end of October, we're excited to share with you the latest developments in our community and project updates. First and foremost, we'd like to thank everyone who contributed to the recent security updates for Thursday. These updates have been issued by AlmaLinux and cover various packages, including AlmaLinux, emacs, expat, gcc-toolset-15-gcc, java-17-openjdk, java-25-openjdk, kernel, kernel-rt, libX11, libXi, libXrender, libXtst, and mod.

In other news, we've received a report from the Linux Plumbers Conference blog about the sched_ext microconference. This conference is a great opportunity for developers to come together and discuss the latest advancements in the Linux community. We're excited to see the progress being made and the new ideas being shared.

On the development front, we've had several commits recently. The intelligence sync has been updated to include the newsletter, archive, wiki guides, and feed for October 29, 2026. Additionally, we've made updates to AcreetionOS-Xlibre, including updating the code and adding new features. We've also added a welcome workflow to acreetionos-plasma and added ShellCheck linting for shell scripts in acreetionos-code-acreetionos-server.

We're always looking for ways to improve our project and make it more accessible to new contributors. To that end, we've added a welcome message for first-time contributors in acreetionos-code-acreetionos-server. This should help new contributors get started with our project more easily.

As we continue to work on AcreetionOS, we're committed to maintaining a secure and private distribution. We're constantly monitoring the latest security updates and patches to ensure our users have the best possible experience.

We're also excited to see the growth of our community and the new projects being developed. Our community is a key part of what makes AcreetionOS special, and we're grateful for everyone's contributions.

If you're interested in getting involved with AcreetionOS, we encourage you to join our Discord server and participate in our discussions. We're always looking for new ideas and perspectives to help shape the future of our project.

As a reminder, our GitLab instance is available for anyone to use. You can find all the latest updates and commits there, and we encourage you to contribute to our project.

Finally, we'd like to thank our community for their continued support and enthusiasm. We're excited to see what the future holds for AcreetionOS and look forward to working with all of you.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift, Co-Lead Developers of AcreetionOS
